title: The Knot Checklist Completion Burn-Up
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:checklist`), seating revisions (`event:seating`), vendor contracts (`event:vendor`), deposits (`event:deposit`), planning syncs (`event:sync`).
app: Wedding and event-planning telemetry — The Knot checklist exports, seating-chart revisions, vendor deposit schedules, and RSVP operations — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:checklist milestone_name=* completed=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(completed="yes",1,0))) as matched by milestone_name
| eval a_completed_task_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_completed_task_pct
description: Measures the percentage of The Knot checklist tasks that end with a completed task by milestone.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which milestone are helping or hurting The Knot checklist tasks.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a completed task` on `event:checklist` events and summarize the hit rate by `milestone_name`.
visualization: Table of milestone with percentage of The Knot checklist tasks ending with a completed task.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how often a completed task happens for each milestone so you can see where The Knot checklist tasks go smoothly or get stuck.
